scale_metadata.render_scope: full document; all pages rendered at 150 DPI
preserved_parent_behaviour: all parent chapter headings and their order
correction register, metadata, revision history, workflow and retirement tables with the frozen public values
release margins (0.8 in), footer with page field, header band, title/heading/table-header styling and core properties
page breaks before Distribution and Training Workflow and Final Release Appendix
byte-deterministic output and DRAFT-source verification
changed_parent_behaviour: the Controlled Document Register table now holds one real row per declared record instead of a fixed register, so table row count is driven by the actual record count
the register narrative reports the actual record count

modified_steps: 01 build: stage order and processing tools unchanged from the frozen 001 create_packet.py; the correction register and every release chapter are derived from the frozen records.json, and the controlled document register table iterates all N records (one real row per record), so output size is driven by the actual record count
02 validate: dynamic validator reads frozen expected.json and covers every record plus document-level controls (metadata/style/margin/footer/header checks run once, not repeated per record)
03 render: unchanged LibreOffice -> PDF -> 150 DPI PNG render; page count is decided by real layout

scale_metadata.parameterized: Fixed scope of five public page types per hearing group is parameterized over all groups: global page numbers, footers 'page / total', appendix and packet-content page targets and bookmark targets are absolute across the whole packet.
scale_metadata.preserved_parent_behavior: 144 DPI pdftoppm page rendering; Letter portrait pages; public metadata model; ReportLab page construction finalized with pypdf bookmarks/metadata; no AcroForm/annotation handling is introduced (the parameterized rebuild neither reads nor writes AcroForm structures).
scale_metadata.changed_parent_behavior: The builder iterates every notices.json hearing group through the real five-page drawing functions instead of building a single fixed docket; pages are never duplicated from a 5-page base.

modified_steps: 01 build: page sizes, portrait rules, fonts, drawing helpers and pageCompression are unchanged; the builder iterates notices.json hearing groups (5 pages per group), global page numbers, footers and bookmark targets are computed over all groups
02 render: unchanged pdftoppm -png -r 144 over the output PDF
03 validate: dynamic validator reads frozen expected.json and checks every group's pages, facts, bookmarks and forbidden tokens

scale_metadata.parameterized: The fixed 7-page source block and 6-page live scope are parameterized over all groups: source page indexes, obsolete page indexes, absolute bookmark targets and page-label prefixes are computed over the whole scaled binder.
scale_metadata.preserved_parent_behavior: 130 DPI pdftoppm page rendering with montage 3x2, geometry +18+24 and -label %f contact sheet; page labels equal the visible section titles; input metadata preserved with /Title overridden to 'Closeout Binder'; no AcroForm handling is introduced (the rebuild neither reads nor writes AcroForm structures).
scale_metadata.changed_parent_behavior: The builder iterates every groups.json group through the real read-strip-drop-reorder-labelling path instead of a single fixed 7-page seed; live pages are never duplicated.

modified_steps: 01 build_and_pdfinfo: unchanged; the builder iterates groups.json groups (7 source pages per group -> 6 live pages), removing the 'Draft: ' prefix, dropping the obsolete divider, reordering live pages and adding bookmarks/page labels over the whole binder
02 final_text: unchanged pdftotext -layout over the output PDF
03 page_labels_and_bookmarks: unchanged pypdf page-label and outline dump, now spanning all scaled groups

04 render_contact_sheet: unchanged pdftoppm -png -r 130 + one montage 3x2 -label %f invocation over every retained live page; because the montage tile grid is 3x2 and the retained page count (30/120) exceeds 6, ImageMagick writes one numbered contact-sheet tile (output-contact-0.png, ...) per 3x2 grid page instead of a single output-contact.png. The command lists all produced tiles; this is the same single tool invocation as the parent, scaled by page count
05 forbidden_text_diagnostic: unchanged pdftotext | rg over the output PDF
